title: Create issue
description: Keep your draft while you choose fields and add a description.
accessRequired: Current workspace access is required. Your local draft is kept.
created: The issue was created. Your draft is kept until you open it.
titleBoundary: Remove spaces at the beginning or end of the title before saving.
validation: Check the fields and description. Your draft is kept.
filesSeparate: Add files after the issue is created. File binding is a separate action.
uncertain: The save outcome is unknown. Review current access, then retry the same request.
rejected: The request was rejected. Review current access before retrying or editing.
saveError: The draft could not be confirmed as saved. It is kept here.
reviewError: Current access could not be reviewed. Your captured request is kept.
